jobs.title: Service Delivery Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities Own service delivery and operational performance across a portfolio of approximately 10–15 enterprise customers, with additional support for smaller accounts when required. Coordinate with technical and development teams to ensure accurate, timely data delivery in line with SLAs, contractual commitments, and customer expectations. Monitor data pipelines, feed performance, costs, delivery schedules, uptime, and quality indicators, identifying operational risks early and driving them through to resolution. Manage the complete lifecycle of customer change requests, from initial scoping through delivery and billing, in collaboration with Account Management and Sales teams. Oversee project efficiency, margins, and profitability, partnering with technical teams to identify operational inefficiencies and manage expenditure trends. Build trusted customer relationships through proactive communication, transparent reporting, and a strong understanding of customer objectives and evolving requirements. Serve as the primary escalation point for service issues, representing customer priorities internally and coordinating timely resolution. Work cross-functionally with Engineering, QA, Product, Infrastructure, Project Management, Account Management, and Sales teams to align priorities, timelines, renewals, and delivery commitments. Drive complex operational issues, including infrastructure challenges, service-level concerns, and data delivery risks, through to resolution while keeping stakeholders informed. Define, track, and communicate KPIs covering data quality, delivery performance, uptime, MTTR, feed health, and pipeline integrity. Translate technical and operational performance data into clear, actionable business language for customers, internal stakeholders, and leadership. Maintain accurate engagement status tracking and provide regular visibility into risks, trends, service performance, and commercial considerations. Requirements 5+ years of experience in service delivery, account operations, customer operations, or a similar client-facing operational role. Proven experience managing enterprise customers or complex client portfolios with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts and performance data into clear business language. Demonstrated experience managing SLAs, KPIs, operational reporting, and service performance in a customer-facing environment. Strong commercial awareness, including experience monitoring project efficiency, margins, costs, or profitability. Ability to analyse and articulate service metrics such as uptime, MTTR, data quality, and data pipeline integrity. Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce and operational reporting or performance management tools. Proven ability to identify data delivery and operational risks, manage escalations, and drive issues through to resolution. Experience translating statements of work and customer requirements into effective project delivery and measurable outcomes. Strong problem-solving and cross-functional coordination skills, with a proactive approach to preventing recurring issues. Ability to build trusted relationships and communicate confidently with enterprise customers and internal technical teams. Familiarity with web scraping, data pipelines, data extraction, or data services is a strong advantage. Comfortable working in a multicultural, distributed, and technology-focused environment. Benefits Competitive compensation of €55,000–€62,000 per year. Fully remote working arrangement with flexibility in how and where you work. Opportunity to work with cutting-edge open-source technologies and tools. Collaboration with a self-motivated, progressive, and multicultural team. Exposure to complex enterprise customers and large-scale data delivery operations. Opportunity to develop expertise across service delivery, technical operations, customer success, and commercial performance. Lead the use of AI-powered tools such as ChatGPT, SurferSEO, and NeuronWriter to improve content ideation, production, and optimisation workflows. Develop AI search optimisation strategies designed to improve visibility across conversational and AI-powered search experiences, including featured snippets, summarisation systems, voice search, and zero-click results. Monitor search algorithm updates, emerging AI technologies, and changes in user intent and discovery behaviour. Track campaign performance using GA4, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Looker Studio, and related SEO platforms. Analyse performance data, identify opportunities, and translate insights into clear client-facing recommendations and reports. Continuously adapt SEO and AI visibility strategies based on performance data, industry developments, and changes in the search landscape. Contribute to the evolution of SEO services, processes, and AI-enhanced capabilities across the wider team. Requirements 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience with a strong portfolio of successful campaigns and measurable results. Proven experience managing SEO clients or leading accounts within a digital marketing agency, consultancy, or similarly fast-paced environment. Strong technical SEO knowledge, including site architecture, structured data, Core Web Vitals, on-page optimisation, and technical audits. Strong understanding of keyword research, search intent, content strategy, internal linking, authority building, and off-site SEO. Demonstrated ability to develop and execute comprehensive SEO strategies across multiple clients or industries. Experience using SEO and analytics platforms such as GA4, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Looker Studio. Practical familiarity with AI tools and workflows relevant to SEO, content creation, and optimisation. Strong understanding of AI-influenced search, LLM-based discovery, conversational search, and the evolving relationship between traditional SEO and AI visibility. Ability to identify emerging search trends and translate them into actionable strategies for clients. Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to different audiences. Strong client management and stakeholder communication skills, with confidence leading strategic conversations and performance reviews. Highly organised, analytical, adaptable, and comfortable working in a rapidly evolving digital environment. Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Information Technology, or a related discipline is preferred but not essential. Willingness to complete a practical SEO assessment as part of the selection process, demonstrating strategic thinking across on-page, content, E-E-A-T, off-page, technical SEO, and AI visibility. Attend industry trade exhibitions and conferences as requested. Cority software knowledge an asset Qualifications: Must have a university degree in business or equivalent work experience. Must have at least 3 years’ experience in sales, account management or business development. Must have the ability to work independently as well as on a team. Must possess strong organization and time management skills. Must feel confident demonstrating the Cority application. Must have excellent interpersonal skills.
